aiSettings.title: AI Settings
aiSettings.configHelp: You can configure independent API keys and base URLs for different AI providers. The selected provider will be used as the global default model.
aiSettings.apiKeyTooltip: Each provider uses its own API key

inspectionSettings.title: Inspection Request and Record Settings
inspectionSettings.incomingMaterialFreeInputLabel: Use free-text material input for incoming requests
inspectionSettings.manualCreateLabel: Allow Manual Creation of Inspection Records
inspectionSettings.manualCreateDesc: When disabled, users cannot manually create incoming, process, or shipping inspection records via the "Create" button; records auto-generated by closing inspection requests are not affected.
inspectionSettings.noPermission: You do not have permission to edit this setting
inspectionSettings.projectionRolloutDesc: Historical facts remain unchanged. The switch is available only after shadow reconciliation passes.
inspectionSettings.projectionBlocked: Projection rollout is blocked until freshness, baseline, and shadow checks pass.
inspectionSettings.projectionEnableConfirm: Projection reads will be enabled only after the server confirms every safety gate.
inspectionSettings.projectionDisableConfirm: Reports will return to the legacy calculation immediately.
inspectionSettings.projectionRebuildConfirm: The report stays on the legacy calculation until a complete generation is published.
inspectionSettings.projectionRebuildQueueFailed: Failed to queue pass-rate projection rebuild
inspectionSettings.uploadTypeDesc: Controls the allowed file formats for all upload endpoints, including anonymous inspection uploads. Formats that can carry scripts (SVG, HTML, macro documents, ...) are always rejected. Changes take effect immediately.

qualityClassification.title: Quality Classification Settings
qualityClassification.description: Primary and secondary categories are isolated to the current business scope. Disabling one does not affect historical records.
qualityClassification.name: Category Name
qualityClassification.codeInvalid: Use only letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
qualityClassification.parentMissing: The primary category no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
qualityClassification.confirmDeleteCategory: Delete this primary category? Its secondary categories will no longer be available for new records.
qualityClassification.noPermission: You do not have permission to edit quality classifications. This page is read-only.
